shots.title: The mistake is still live.
shots.voiceover: The ticket is closed. The mistake is still live.
shots.visualDirectionZh: 概念开场：占画面三分之一的工单落下 Resolved 印章并抽走，露出背后的 100% waterproof。1.2秒停顿，然后切到仍亮着的错误承诺。右下小字 Illustrative scenario。
shots.soundDirectionZh: 一次干净的盖章声；1.8秒切掉混响，留低频脉冲。
shots.evidence: editorial illustration; original fixture in lib/fixtures.ts

shots.title: One page. Two misunderstandings.
shots.voiceover: The bottle looks included. The page promises waterproof protection. The specification says otherwise.
shots.visualDirectionZh: 实物感背包大图，细线框住水瓶；切成原页面承诺与商家规格对照。轻微推近，禁止伪造商品浸水试验。
shots.soundDirectionZh: 玻璃质感轻触两次，低频节拍开始。

shots.title: Pagemi
shots.voiceover: Pagemi turns customer confusion into evidence-linked page repairs. Here is the working prototype, running on Google Cloud.
shots.visualDirectionZh: 3D包装快速压平为真实首页，1秒品牌落版后进入全屏桌面工作台。屏幕角落持续保留 Synthetic demo。
shots.soundDirectionZh: 低音打开到宽立体声；品牌出现不额外爆炸。

shots.title: Read the evidence.
shots.voiceover: Gemini reads feedback, merchant specifications, and the product image. Feedback identifies a problem. The specification supports product facts. An image can show a bottle, but cannot prove waterproof performance.
shots.visualDirectionZh: 真实点击来源，放大规格关键句4秒，再看图片。Run audit实际点击与返回必须录到；如缩短等待，明确标 Analysis wait shortened。
shots.soundDirectionZh: 微弱扫描音只沿来源连线移动，旁白下音乐降低。

shots.title: Repair, ask, or hand off.
shots.voiceover: The agent separates page problems from missing information and operational issues. It corrects the unsupported waterproof claim, asks for laptop dimensions, and leaves a broken zipper or late delivery for human action.
shots.visualDirectionZh: 三项实际问题依次选中，各停3–4秒，红色过度声明、琥珀色缺资料、灰色人工处理。不要给每条反馈都闪绿色勾。
shots.soundDirectionZh: 有节制的三次状态声；没有成功庆祝音。

shots.title: Every change has a source.
shots.voiceover: Each proposed change shows its source. A separate Gemini request checks the replacement text. Program rules restrict edits to three fields. Price, inventory, policies, and certifications stay outside the editing scope.
shots.visualDirectionZh: 真实前后差异与来源并排；将不支持的 waterproof 词组与受支持文字进行匹配剪辑。其余界面不扭曲。批准前保留人审复选框。
shots.soundDirectionZh: 细线连上时轻响；旁白读 source 时停留。

shots.title: New evidence. Old approval expires.
shots.voiceover: Approval applies to exact wording and exact evidence. When the merchant adds a new specification, that approval becomes outdated. The application requires a fresh assessment before publication.
shots.visualDirectionZh: 第一次真正批准之后补充规格。特写实际 Outdated 状态；外层批准连接线从绿变琥珀并断开。静止2秒让评委理解。
shots.soundDirectionZh: 音乐抽空0.4秒；低而短的失效提示音，无刺耳警报。
shots.evidence: Take B; domain invalidation tests; no final-prompt live clip yet

shots.title: Dimensions, without an invented promise.
shots.voiceover: We add measured sleeve dimensions. A new assessment can disclose those measurements and ask customers to check their device. Dimensions alone do not guarantee that every sixteen-inch laptop fits.
shots.visualDirectionZh: 录入32×23×3厘米的合成商家规格并重审。只有真实返回安全尺寸建议才展示成功；保留尺寸提示和未保证通用兼容的措辞。
shots.soundDirectionZh: 节拍恢复，三段刻度线跟随真实尺寸；不画未测量的电脑适配。
shots.evidence: Take B; historical screenshot is reference only

shots.title: Approve. Publish. Read it back.
shots.voiceover: Now the merchant reviews and approves the new text. Publication creates a persistent page version. We open the storefront, refresh it, and read the published result back. Writing succeeded and content verification are separate checks.
shots.visualDirectionZh: 至少12秒连续真实操作：勾选、批准、发布、打开页面、刷新、复查。其余6–10秒特写变更文字和实际版本；剪辑不能省略授权顺序。
shots.soundDirectionZh: 鼠标点击轻音；只在真正发布完成后出现低音落点，复查再一个柔和确认。

shots.title: A way back.
shots.voiceover: If a change needs to be reversed, the merchant restores an earlier page. Restoration creates another recorded version. The history remains visible, and the restored content can be checked again.
shots.visualDirectionZh: 真实点击恢复和刷新，旧措辞重新出现，新版本号递增。严禁用倒放页面切换假装回滚。
shots.soundDirectionZh: 机械归位感轻响，不反放前一段音频。

shots.title: Tested. With limits visible.
shots.voiceover: The release passed five consecutive public workflows and thirty-five local tests. The five journeys took twenty to sixty-nine seconds. Earlier revisions had timeout failures. Human accuracy grading and merchant testing are still pending.
shots.visualDirectionZh: 5条真实耗时线依次出现34.8、69.5、29.2、20.2、30.9秒；下方常驻 Synthetic tests。展示早前504失败且无可批准补丁。禁止标100% accuracy。
shots.soundDirectionZh: 音乐缩减到脉冲，让数字读得清楚。

shots.title: Google AI, controlled execution.
shots.voiceover: Gemini runs through Vertex AI. Cloud Run serves the application, Firestore records versions, and private Cloud Storage holds uploaded images. The model has no publishing tool.
shots.visualDirectionZh: 简洁四节点架构。商家批准位于模型和发布之间。模型到发布之间不画直连箭头。文字足够大，不展示密钥或云账单。
shots.soundDirectionZh: 脉冲逐渐合并，避免音效盖住技术名称。

shots.title: Fix the page. Not just the ticket.
shots.voiceover: Our next test is with merchants: can they make accurate repairs with less effort? Pagemi. Fix the page. Not just the ticket.
shots.visualDirectionZh: 回到开场同一构图，错误承诺已被真实批准后的文字替代；最后6秒定格品牌、Google Cloud服务文字和短仓库链接，按钮感入口只作落版。
shots.soundDirectionZh: 温暖双音收束；末尾0.5秒自然衰减，不突然截断。
shots.evidence: future research hypothesis; measured business impact not claimed
